sample_overview: The Transformer replaces recurrent and convolutional layers in sequence transduction with pure attention mechanisms, enabling parallelization and achieving state-of-the-art translation performance with reduced training time.

This survey provides a comprehensive, concise overview of recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs), covering architectural innovations, training strategies, fine-tuning, multimodal applications, and key challenges in the field.

QWEN introduces a series of large language models with varying parameter sizes, including base pretrained models, chat models fine-tuned via SFT/RLHF, and specialized variants for coding and mathematics, achieving state-of-the-art performance on diverse benchmarks while maintaining open-source accessibility.

DeepSeek-V3 introduces an auxiliary-loss-free Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with Multi-Head Latent Attention (MLA) and Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) for efficient, high-performance large language model training.

Qwen3-VL introduces a multimodal foundation model with 256K-token native context, advanced architectural upgrades (Interleaved MRoPE, DeepStack, timestamp tokens), and optimized training pipelines to achieve superior performance across text, vision, and multimodal reasoning tasks while preserving linguistic proficiency.
